payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: make sase-core check.sh export the selected uv Python libdir on LD_LIBRARY_PATH - default just check selected python3.14, but PyO3 tests could not load libpython3.14.so.1.0 until that libdir was added.

Verified cargo fmt; cargo test -p sase_core model_alias_shortcut; cargo test -p sase_core_py model_shortcut; cargo test -p sase_core_py model_alias_shortcut; cargo test -p sase_xprompt_lsp model_shortcut; cargo test -p sase_xprompt_lsp model_alias_shortcut; reran just check with uv python3.14 LIBDIR on LD_LIBRARY_PATH after default loader failure; final epic-symbols check reported no entries.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Full ACE visual suite has unrelated snapshot drift - targeted model-completion visual module passes, but full just test-visual reported 35 non-model snapshot failures needing separate triage.

Verified linked sase-core just check with LD_LIBRARY_PATH, main just check, focused model-completion and visual tests, install/rust-lsp install, sase-nvim LSP/native-completion smoke and Lua tests, and full just check-full.

LANDING AUDIT / INTERRUPTED CLOSE: Reviewed the epic, linked plan, both child beads and all notes; verified landed core commits 6b84036 and 937bab2, SASE fb3ff1589, Neovim 3d17044, and current source. Core unsafe-value validation, ACE structured advisory/scoped highlighting, focused lifecycle coverage, and eight requested model PNG states are present. Six newly added monitor actuals are byte-identical to their goldens and visual inspection found the full light/dark, filtered, scoped narrow, stacked, advisory, loading, and unavailable frames legible. Follow-up sase-yw.3.1#1 is exact ready task sase-xv and received +1. Follow-up sase-yw.3.2#1 is the standing visual backlog task sase-x5 and received +1; its distinct hard-assertion and saturated-lane cases also corroborated sase-yu and sase-yv. Monitor ctqf1ce930m4 reproduced core status 127 from missing libpython3.14.so.1.0 and visual status 1 with 36 failed / 869 passed / 1 skipped; no model-completion visual node was in that failure list. All three repositories equal origin master. Post-start drift is otherwise compatible, but release integration remains: SASE pins core 5fc84c5 / 0.32.60, permits and locks 0.32.59, while structured provider_display landed in 937bab2 and first shipped in 0.32.61 at 7444d15; allowed older bindings drop that field. The Neovim smoke still uses synchronous raw requests, private conversion, direct apply_text_edits, and buffer resets for the final star transitions, so it does not prove the claimed live native popup lifecycle. Epic-symbols currently reports none. Do not close: a child remaining-work plan with release-integration and native-frontend phases is being proposed.
